description: Defines data structures, functions, and classes related to QUIC packet processing in the quic namespace, including packet headers, encryption, and connection ID handling.

classes.name: QuicPacketHeader
classes.description: Represents the header of a QUIC packet, including connection IDs, packet number, version info, and other header fields.

classes.name: QuicPublicResetPacket
classes.description: Represents a public reset packet in QUIC, used for connection reset signaling.

classes.name: QuicVersionNegotiationPacket
classes.description: Represents a version negotiation packet in QUIC, listing supported versions.

classes.name: QuicIetfStatelessResetPacket
classes.description: Represents an IETF QUIC stateless reset packet.

classes.name: QuicData
classes.description: Base class for QUIC data buffers, providing access to raw data.

classes.name: QuicPacket
classes.description: Represents a QUIC packet, including header and payload data.

classes.name: QuicReceivedPacket
classes.description: Represents a received QUIC packet with receipt time and metadata.

classes.name: SerializedPacket
classes.description: Contains information about a serialized (encrypted) QUIC packet.

classes.name: ReceivedPacketInfo
classes.description: Parsed information from the unencrypted bytes of a received packet.

methods.name: GetServerConnectionIdAsRecipient
methods.description: Returns the destination connection ID when perspective is server, source when client.

methods.name: GetClientConnectionIdAsRecipient
methods.description: Returns the destination connection ID when perspective is client, source when server.

methods.name: GetServerConnectionIdAsSender
methods.description: Returns the destination connection ID when perspective is server, source when client.

methods.name: GetServerConnectionIdIncludedAsSender
methods.description: Returns the included destination connection ID when perspective is server, source when client.

methods.name: GetClientConnectionIdAsSender
methods.description: Returns the destination connection ID when perspective is client, source when server.

methods.name: GetClientConnectionIdIncludedAsSender
methods.description: Returns the included source connection ID when perspective is client, destination when server.

methods.name: GetIncludedConnectionIdLength
methods.description: Calculates the number of connection ID bytes included over the wire.

methods.name: GetIncludedDestinationConnectionIdLength
methods.description: Calculates the number of destination connection ID bytes included.

methods.name: GetIncludedSourceConnectionIdLength
methods.description: Calculates the number of source connection ID bytes included.

methods.name: GetPacketHeaderSize
methods.description: Calculates the size of the packet header based on version and header fields.

methods.name: GetStartOfEncryptedData
methods.description: Returns the index of the first byte of encrypted data in a packet.
